prompt:
Subject: Eyes paused on a page

Main Subject:
A vertical 4:5 indoor portrait. A composed adult woman lies prone on olive green bedding, holding an open book with both hands. The subject is positioned slightly to the right of the center, showing from head to waist prominently, with bent legs raised in the upper-left background. The figure occupies about 70% of the screen.

Person/Expression:
A natural and realistic adult woman. A mature feminine physique with a slender model-like build. Long dark brown hair spreads softly from shoulders to bedding, with thin bangs over the forehead. Delicate brown eye makeup, pale rose cheeks, and natural pink-beige lips. Head tilted slightly to the right, looking toward the camera while reading. The expression is calm and slightly pensive.

Clothing/Pose:
Elegant ivory V-neck camisole dress. The chest is naturally and tastefully open, showing fine lace edges and soft cotton material. Elbows on the bedding, left hand supporting the book's spine, and right fingers lightly pressing the page edge. Knees bent with bare feet raised and lightly crossed behind. The body weight creates natural depressions and wrinkles in the bedding.

Background/Light:
A warm private room with wooden shelves, houseplants, an old globe, dried flowers, and small speakers. Pale green curtains in the back right. Warm low sunlight from the upper left window illuminates the hair outline, shoulders, cheeks, arms, and top of the legs. Shadows fall softly toward the bottom right, with weak reflected light from the green bedding back onto the skin.

Composition/Camera:
Eye-level shot nearly level with the bed. 50mm equivalent, shallow depth of field. Focus on the face and the book, with background shelves and globe softly blurred. Large space of bedding left at the bottom, creating a diagonal flow from the feet (top-left) to the book (bottom-right).

Texture/Style:
Japanese lifestyle photography utilizing natural light. Maintains fine skin texture, avoiding excessive smoothing. Warm amber highlights and calm olive green tones. Soft film grain, subtle contrast, delicate hair translucency, and a tactile feel of fabric and paper.

Negative:
Childish appearance, unnatural face, unnatural gaze, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused limbs, broken joints, poor contact with the book, floating, unnatural gravity, incorrect perspective, shadows inconsistent with light source, gibberish text, extra text, logos, watermarks, plastic-like skin.
